report.summary: The execution timed out while Step 2 fetch_tickets was running. The root cause is confirmed by the deterministic signature timeout_in_step.

root_cause.statement: The execution timed out while Step 2 fetch_tickets was running; that step never finished.

The execution ended with the error TimeoutError: Execution timed out after 141649 ms..

hypotheses.statement: The execution timed out while Step 2 fetch_tickets was running; that step never finished.
